statement: For every simple SRG(99,14,1,2) adjacency matrix A and its complete99x231 binary triangle incidence matrix N, let H=A+7I, G=H mod3, V=ker G and j be the all-one vector. The divided form beta(x,y)=xhat^T H yhat/3 mod3 is well-defined on V, has rank43 and radical span(j); ker(N^T mod3) contains j and is beta-totally-isotropic. Consequently dim ker(N^T mod3)<=22 and77<=rank_F3 N<=98. This conditional necessary condition forces neither a nonconstant left-kernel vector nor target existence/nonexistence.
